relative_definition: per tensor ||new - old||_inf / ||old||_inf (max-norm relative); worst = maximum over tensors, batches and parameter sets

batches.source: train split, seed42 epoch-1 shuffle order, first batches, batch_size 128

timing.setup: GPU3 only; same 35 real batches and identical fresh seed42 parameters for OLD and NEW; 5 warmup + 30 measured steps per block; ABBA block order; CUDA synchronized around each timed region; transfer = pinned host batch to GPU (non_blocking, as training); fullstep = transfer + zero_grad + forward + loss + backward + AdamW step; breakdown blocks synchronize between phases, fullstep blocks only at step boundaries; eval = no_grad eval forward. Collation (CPU, DataLoader workers in training) is reported separately.
timing.note: Measured per-step times on these batches only; four original jobs (GPU4-7) share host CPUs.
